questions.question: The mean proportional of (a + b) (a - b)³, (a + b)³ (a - b) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:** 

First number = (a + b) (a - b)3

Second number = (a + b)3 (a - b)

**Formula used:**

Mean proportional = √(Product of numbers)

**Calculation:**

Mean proportional = √{(a + b) × (a - b)3} × {(a + b)3 × (a - b)}

⇒ √{(a + b) × (a - b)² ×(a - b) × (a + b)2 ×(a + b) × (a - b)}

⇒ √{(a - b)4 × (a + b)⁴}

⇒ (a - b)2 × (a + b)2

**∴ The correct option is 1.**

questions.question: A cuboid with sides 4, 6 and 8 units is covered with paper. The paper is removed and a square is made from it. What is the side (in units) of the square?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total area of the paper = Total Surface Area of the cuboid.

TSA = 2 × (lb + bh + hl) = 2 × (48 + 24 + 32) = 208 sq. units.

The paper forms a square, so Area of square = side² = 208.

side = √208 ≈ 14.42 units (since 14² = 196 and 15² = 225).

**∴ The correct answer is 14.42 units.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 8 4 6 Cuboid 
• 
 Unfolded Area = 208 a a Square 

**Given:**

Sides of the cuboid:

Length (l) = 8 units

Breadth (b) = 6 units

Height (h) = 4 units

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area of Cuboid = 2 × (lb + bh + hl)

Area of Square = a² (where a is the side of the square)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area of the paper used to cover the cuboid = Total Surface Area of the cuboid

⇒ Area = 2 × (8 × 6 + 6 × 4 + 4 × 8)

⇒ Area = 2 × (48 + 24 + 32)

⇒ Area = 2 × 104 = 208 sq. units

This same paper is completely used to form a square. Therefore, the area of the square is equal to the area of the paper.

⇒ Area of the square = 208 sq. units

⇒ a² = 208

⇒ a = √208

We know that 14² = 196 and 15² = 225. Thus, √208 lies between 14 and 15.

⇒ a ≈ 14.42 units

**∴ The correct answer is 14.42 units.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of a Cuboid

It is the sum of the areas of its 6 rectangular faces. The formula is given by TSA = 2(lb + bh + hl).

Area and Perimeter of a Square

For a square with side length 'a', the Area is calculated as a² and the total perimeter boundary is 4a.

Conservation of Surface Area

When a 2D sheet such as paper or foil is unwrapped from a 3D object and reshaped without cutting or overlapping, its total surface area remains perfectly constant.

questions.question: S deposits a total of ₹50,000 in two accounts which give 8% and 12% simple interest annually, respectively. After one year, he gets a total ₹5,200. How much money does he deposit in the account with a 12% interest rate?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs.50,000

First rate = 8%; second rate = 12%

Total simple interest (S.I) = Rs.5200

**Formula used:**

Simple interest (S.I) = (P × R × T)/100

Where P = principal; R = rate; T = time

**Calculation:**

Let the amount at 12% rate = x

then amount at 8% rate = (50,000 - x)

According to the question:

⇒ (50,000 - x) × 8% + x × 12% = 5200

⇒​ (50,000 × 8%) - (x × 8%) + (x × 12%) = 5200

⇒ (x × 4%) = 5200 - 4000

⇒ x = (1200 × 100)/4 = Rs.30000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.30000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] 

**__Shortcut Trick__****Calculation:**

Overall rate = (5200 × 100)/50000 = 52/5 = 10.4%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79abc696df3155a3bcfa94d22605fd0a21935bdd44d8a8f56503b20d71abab88.png] 

Now 

Amount at 8% : Amount at 12% = 1.6 : 2.4

⇒ 2 : 3

⇒ 5 units = 50000

⇒ 3 units = (50000 × 3)/5 = Rs.30000

∴ The correct answer is Rs.30000.

questions.question: Tarun owned a plot of land having an area that was 10% more than the area of the plot owned by Basab, while the area of the plot of land owned by Nakul was 40% more than the area of the plot owned by Tarun. If the area of the plot owned by Nakul was 2695 square feet, what was the area (in square feet) of the plot owned by Basab?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Tarun plot = 110% × Basab plot

Nakul plot = 140% × Tarun plot

Area of Nakul plot = 2695 feet²

**Calculation:**

Tarun plot : Basab plot = 110 : 100 = 11 : 10

Nakul plot : Tarun plot = 140 : 100 = 7 : 5

Tarun plot must be same so

Tarun plot : Basab plot = (11 : 10) × 5 = 55 : 50

Nakul plot : Tarun plot = (7 : 5) × 11 = 77 : 55

Tarun plot : Basab plot : Nakul plot = 55 : 50 : 77

Now, 77 units = 2695 feet²

⇒ Basab plot = 50 units = (2695 × 50)/77

⇒ Basab plot = 35 × 50 = 1750 feet²

**∴ The correct answer is 1750 feet2.**

questions.question: A shopkeeper purchased 1600 mangoes at the rate of ₹120 per dozen. Out of these, he sold 900 mangoes at ₹15 per mango and the remaining mangoes at ₹14 per mango. His gain percentage is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total quantity of mangoes = 1600

Cost price of mangoes = Rs.120/dozen

**Formula used:**

Gain = (S.P - C.P)

Gain% = (P × 100)/C.P

Where, P = profit; C.P = cost price; S.P = selling price

**Calculation:**

Price of 12 mangoes = 120

Price of 1 mango = 120/12 = 10

Total C.P = 1600 × 10 = Rs.16000

Total S.P = 900 × 15 + 700 × 14

⇒ 13500 + 9800 = 23300

Gain = (23300 - 16000) = Rs.7300

Gain% = (Gain × 100)/C.P

⇒ (7300 × 100)/16000 

⇒ 730/16 = 45.625%

**∴ The correct answer is 45.625%.**

questions.question: A thief steals an item and escapes, running at a speed of 15 km/h. A policeman arrives at the spot of the crime after 4 minutes and immediately starts chasing the thief. 16 minutes after the policeman started to chase the thief; there is still a gap of 200 m between the two. At what distance from the spot of the crime will the policeman catch up the thief and what is the speed (in km/h) of the policeman?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of thief = 15 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Distance = relative speed × time

**Calculation:**

Distance covered by thief in 20 minutes = 15 × (20/60) = 5 km

Since there is a gap of 200,m = 5 - 0.2 = 4.8 km. 

Distance covered by a policeman in 16 minutes = 4.8 km

⇒ Speed of policeman × (16/60) = 4.8

⇒ Speed of policeman = (4.8 × 60)/16 = 18 km/hr

Now,

Distance = relative speed × time

⇒ 200 = (18 - 15) × (5/18) × time

⇒ Time = (200 × 18)/(3 × 5)

⇒ Time = 240 sec

Distance covered by thief = (15 × 240)/3600 = 1 km

Total distance covered by thief = 5 + 1 = 6 km

**∴ The correct option is 2.**

questions.question: A 40 - litre mixture contains 25% alcohol and 75% water. If 10 litres of water are added to the mixture, the percentage of alcohol in the new mixture is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The total quantity of mixture = 40 litres

**Calculation:**

Alcohol present in mixture = 40 × 25% = 10 litres

Water present in mixture = 40 - 10 = 30 litres

10 litres of water is added to the mixture.

New quantity of water = 30 + 10 = 40 litres

Percentage of alcohol in mixture = (10 × 100)/50 = 20% 

**∴ The correct answer is 20%.**

questions.question: The marked price of a microwave oven is ₹15,990 and it is sold for ₹12,792. What is the rate of discount offered?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price (M.P) = Rs.15990

Selling price (S.P) = Rs.12792

**Formula used:**

Discount = (M.P - S.P)

Discount% = (discount × 100)/M.P

**Calculation:**

Discount = (15990 - 12792) = Rs.3198

Discount% = (discount × 100)/M.P

⇒ (3198 × 100)/15990

⇒ 2 × 10 = 20%

**∴ The correct answer is 20%.**

questions.question: 20 women and 15 men together can complete a work in 6 days. It takes 150 days for a single woman to complete the work. In how many days can a single man complete the work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(20 women + 15 men) can complete a work = 6 days

1 woman can complete the same work = 150 days

**Formula used:**

Total work = efficiency × time

**Calculation:**

Let the man efficiency = M

and the woman's efficiency = W

According to the question:

⇒ (20 W + 15 M) × 6 = W × 150

⇒​ 20 W + 15 M = W × 25

⇒​ 15 M = 25 W - 20 W

⇒​ M/W = 5/15 = 1/3

Total work = W × 150

⇒ 3 × 150 = 450 units

Time taken to complete the work by 1 man = 450/1 = 450 days

**∴ The correct answer is 450 days.**

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 44?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

Divisibility rule of 44:

If a number is divisible by 4 and 11, then the number is also divisible by 44.

Divisibility rule of 11:

If the difference between odd places and even places is either 0 or divisible by 11,

then the number is divisible by 11.

Divisibility rule of 4:

If the last two digits of a number are divisible by 4, then the number is divisible by 4. 

**Calculation:**

We need to check it by option:

Option 1:

Number = 32802

Last two digits = 02

2 is not divisible by 4. So the number is not divisible by 4.

The number is not divisible by 44.

Option 2:

Number = 54736

Last two digits = 36

36 is divisible by 4. So the number is divisible by 4.

Sum of digits at odd places = 5 + 7 + 6 = 18

The sum of digits at even places = 4 + 3 = 7 

Difference between the sum of odd places and even = (18 - 7) = 11

11 is divisible by 11. So the number is divisible by 11.

The number is divisible by 11 and 4. So the number is divisible by 44.

**∴ The correct option is 2.**
